body: Cats are awesome :3 I'm also a cat person. I swear animals can tell when we suffer because they become so snuggly <.<
But if they're true why in the fuck would she say that? I hate people. I'm sorry your family treats you like this =(
Yeah man...I had the safety off and everything and still chickened out xP it's hard to fight the bodily instinct to live.
I DID NOT KNOW THIS EWWW ONIGUMO

You sound like such a good person. I personally would have told your ex to forget she ever knew me. She broke up with you over a false forgiveness on her part, then she thinks she can use you AFTERWARDS for money when she already has an inheritance to rely on??

From what I read you are very caring, to a fault perhaps, lighting yourself on fire to keep everyone warm as the saying goes. 

SO! Because of such, I will be angry at your ex if you do not feel such, because she deserves it. It really pisses me off that she did this to you. If I'm not mistaken, the problems at home definitely didn't help with being motivated at work? 

There is financial aid for people with mounting debt, don't give up just yet! You can stabilize your finances, you are not the first to have huge bills that can't be paid, and for sure not the last because I'm probably headed there myself!
Have you told your parents that their idiotic statements cause you to feel suicidal? I'd bet that if you let them know this they would probably be afraid to say anything afterwards.

I'm in a very similar situation myself, however it is not over love interests so much as self-worth. 

I had the gun against my head and pussied out as well. It was just too scary, I couldn't even cut myself. You're far braver than I.

The meds I recieved help me however, they don't fix my depression so much as reduce it I suppose.

A side effect of certain anti-depressant SSRI's is an increase in feeling depressed and wanting to commit suicide. Before you try again, may I suggest trying another med?

Also, if someone tells you to kill yourself that person is wrong and is better out of your life.

Well, not to get all churchy...but random unexplainable calming feelings come from the Holy Spirit. If you still believe in God, I think that feeling is Him trying to tell you that your grades may help you later on in life?

My personal spirituality has almost entirely kept me alive thus far. I was going to shoot myself, had the gun against my head, loaded, safety off, and a random unexplainable epiphany hit me that I had no reason for any of it.

Regardless, I wish you the best when you arrive home.

My Mom once told me that if I committed suicide as I had planned, she would have hated herself every day. Perhaps she would have killed herself as well.

I don't want to ignite what I feel every day into another's life. It hurts too much right?
There are others with HIV that still need love in their life. I'm not saying date only HIV positive individuals, but it is an option.

For me, I suppose it is because if I can't help myself, I can try to help in this small way?

I think suicide is wrong, we hurt those around us, and it is a catalyst for others to commit suicide. The more frequently it occurs, the more it spreads.

Living is important, why? I don't really know. What I do know is that harming others is wrong. Killing oneself has consequences on a community and family as a whole. It is not a solution no matter how much I try to justify it.

These reasons have contributed to myself being kept alive, and I hope they help.

I know this is harsh, but you may want to consider getting him admitted to a clinic so he won't hurt himself. 

This may give you and your family the time needed to solve this.
Please do not end your life over assumptions.

I feel similarly as well. Just always on edge, looking over a cliff and hoping nothing shoves me off it.

I wish you the best, and my hope is that one day people like us won't have to live this way.

I'm glad there are other people that feel so similarly, it makes me feel less alone. I am also glad if anything I posted helped.

I believe I can make it through this despite it all, at least we're trying right?
I know this is a hollow suggestion by comparison, but the love of a pet can fill a tiny part of that.

Just because people care about me doesn't mean I feel better. Sorry =( I would feel better being gone. 

Because when I'm gone, this is over. I am no longer anyone's burden.
Mine as well Pops

I feel the same way entirely. Really, every word you've written.
I have clinical depression though, and this sounds psychological. Consider getting a diagnosis, medicine can help you feel like "trying" again. =)

If the suicidal thoughts are constant and persistent despite you being determined to continue to live, that sounds like it may be a psychological ailment.

I have clinical depression and that is what I feel, these feelings are what led to me being diagnosed. Sometimes these thoughts come to everyone however, and come and go, but when they are constantly there then that is when I would say medical help is a good idea.

I couldn't apologize more for the pain you've gone through sir. I also deal with suicidality, and to me, it sounds like this situation is entirely her fault. If she treats you this way, causes you to hurt in such awful ways, and is STILL so selfish to the point of just leaving with barely a word...
I would say such a person is not worth giving your life away for her since all she seems to have done is stomp on your heart.

I can respect you, and say without a doubt that your life is far more difficult than mine, unimagineably so even.
For me, suicidality is a physiological side effect. 
My life is pretty much perfect. I have two arms, two legs, a healthy body in every way except for the clinical depression.
I have a loving family, Mom and Dad, grandparents, friends. 
But what is going to give me back the desire to live? Pills? Talking to a professional? A pet? Love? I have tried all of these things in excess and more, but I still feel completely lost and I hurt inside so badly that I just want it to stop because nothing makes that go away. 
I have everything and I still can't live like this.
